text.label: Perform Wai Kru
text.description: Perform Wai Kru, a ritualized dance ceremony associated with Muay Thai. Taking part in a contest or demonstration of the ceremony differs from sparring.

text.label: Practice Sanda wushu
text.description: Practice Sanda wushu in contact bouts, using permitted hand and foot strikes and throws under Sanda rules.

text.label: Perform show skiing
text.description: Take part in show skiing by performing water-ski tricks and synchronized group figures in a staged performance.

text.label: Swim with fins for speed
text.description: Swim using a monofin or two fins, propelling yourself by muscular effort at the surface or underwater.

text.label: Play underwater hockey
text.description: Play at the bottom of a pool: use a short stick to move a puck and score in the opposing team’s goal while swimming with a mask, snorkel, and fins.

text.label: Play underwater rugby
text.description: Play a contact team game underwater: hold and pass a ball and place it in a basket-shaped goal on the pool bottom, using a mask, snorkel, and fins.

text.label: Practice underwater orienteering
text.description: Navigate underwater using a compass and distance measurements, find or pass control points, and complete a set course while remaining submerged.

text.label: Compete in underwater target shooting
text.description: Shoot at a target underwater with a speargun or harpoon while holding your breath. The event scores hits and, in some formats, speed moving between targets.

text.label: Practice mermaiding
text.description: Swim and perform movement or expressive elements at the surface and underwater while wearing a mermaid tail with a monofin.

text.label: Compete in CMAS Aquathlon (underwater wrestling)
text.description: Wrestle one-on-one in and under the water, trying to remove a ribbon from the opponent’s ankle and show it above the water.

text.label: Practice mountain-bike orienteering
text.description: Ride a mountain bike between control points, using a map and route and choosing a path between points.

text.label: Practice ski orienteering
text.description: Use cross-country skis to navigate by map and pass control points along a chosen route.

text.label: Take part in Trail-O
text.description: In Trail-O, determine from a control station which marker corresponds to the control point shown on the map, following the event’s accuracy or timing rules.

text.label: Play field lacrosse
text.description: Play field lacrosse by catching, passing, and throwing a ball with a stick on an outdoor field.

text.label: Play lacrosse Sixes
text.description: Play lacrosse Sixes, a compact, fast-paced format with six players and its own rules.

text.label: Perform kickboxing musical forms
text.description: Perform choreographed individual or group kickboxing movements and techniques to music, without sparring.

text.label: Perform karate kata
text.description: Perform kata in karate: a prescribed sequence of offensive and defensive techniques in a set order and direction.

text.label: Compete in kumite
text.description: Compete in kumite by sparring with a karate opponent and scoring with permitted techniques under WKF rules.

text.label: Play Guts with a flying disc
text.description: Play Guts by throwing a disc at the opposing team, whose players try to catch it in the target zone.

text.label: Perform flying-disc freestyle
text.description: Perform individual or paired trick combinations using a flying disc, with throws and catches.

text.label: Play Double Disc Court
text.description: Play Double Disc Court (DDC): two teams throw two discs at the other side at the same time under DDC rules.

text.label: Take part in Discathon
text.description: Run a course while throwing a disc toward checkpoints or the finish in Discathon.

text.label: Practice accuracy or distance disc throwing
text.description: Practice throwing a flying disc for accuracy or distance. The specific exercise can be recorded separately.

text.label: Perform Self-Caught Flight (MTA/TRC)
text.description: Throw a disc, run or position yourself under its flight, and catch it while recording time or distance in MTA/TRC.

text.label: Play Goaltimate
text.description: Play Goaltimate, a team flying-disc game with goals or a hoop and its own rules.

text.label: Play Discflect
text.description: Play Discflect, a team flying-disc game with a target zone and its own rules.

text.label: Dance disco dance
text.description: Perform choreographed combinations in a disco style to the rhythm of the music, in practice or competition.

text.label: Dance merengue
text.description: Dance merengue using its characteristic partnered or solo step pattern to merengue music.

text.label: Dance American Smooth
text.description: Perform selected American Smooth ballroom dances, with characteristic travel across the floor and partner leading.

text.label: Dance American Rhythm
text.description: Perform selected American Rhythm ballroom dances with a partner, using their characteristic rhythms and technique.

text.label: Dance acrobatic rock and roll
text.description: Dance acrobatic rock and roll as a pair, performing fast rock-and-roll steps, jumps, and supported acrobatic elements.

text.label: Dance boogie-woogie
text.description: Dance Boogie Woogie, a partnered swing dance with characteristic rhythm and steps and competitive improvisation.

text.label: Dance Bugg
text.description: Dance Bugg, a partnered swing dance with characteristic steps and figures under Bugg rules.

text.label: Play carom billiards
text.description: Play carom billiards by striking your cue ball so that it contacts both object balls, under carom rules.

text.label: Play English billiards
text.description: Play English billiards by using a cue to strike the white and object balls and score under English billiards rules.

text.label: Compete in a rally car race
text.description: Compete in an automobile rally by completing timed special stages and the connecting routes under rally rules.

text.label: Compete in an off-road car race or rally raid
text.description: Compete in an off-road automobile race or rally raid, driving a challenging navigation course or special stages under FIA competition rules.

text.label: Fly a glider
text.description: Pilot an unpowered aircraft and use rising air currents to gain altitude and travel along a route.

text.label: Perform aerobatics in an airplane or glider
text.description: Perform aerobatic maneuvers in an airplane or glider, completing a sequence of figures in a defined airspace.

text.label: Take part in aeromodelling
text.description: Take part in the aeromodelling family of activities. Building a model and operating it in flight are distinct activities and may be timed separately, or the user may record the full aeromodelling session.

text.label: Fly a microlight or paramotor
text.description: A flight-family option covering two distinct piloted aircraft modes. Record the whole selected flight session or refine it to one of the two modes.

text.label: Pilot a sport drone on a course or race
text.description: Pilot a sport drone through an obstacle course or race using a visual feed or FPV.

text.label: Pilot a helicopter in a sport event
text.description: Pilot a helicopter in a sport task, flying a route or performing maneuvers under Rotorcraft rules.

text.label: Practice motorcycle trials
text.description: Ride slowly through obstacle sections on a motorcycle, maintaining balance and avoiding touches or penalties.

text.label: Take part in a motorcycle rally raid or cross-country event
text.description: Ride a long off-road route in a motorcycle cross-country or rally raid event, following its navigation rules.

text.label: Play bandy
text.description: Play bandy on an ice field, using sticks to move a ball and score goals under bandy rules.

text.label: Play rink bandy
text.description: Play rink bandy, a version of bandy on a smaller ice surface with a corresponding team size and rules.

text.label: Play short bandy
text.description: Play short bandy on a shorter field under the rules of this short-format version.

text.label: Play Basque pelota: Mano
text.description: Play without a racket, using the hand to send the pelota alternately to the front wall of a fronton or trinquet. Protective joint pads do not change the way the game is played.

text.label: Play Basque pelota: Frontball
text.description: Play by hand on a court with one front wall, striking a rubber ball into the permitted wall area and returning it to the opponent.

text.label: Play Basque pelota: Frontenis
text.description: Play frontenis by hitting a ball with a racket against the front wall of a fronton and returning it to the playing area under this form of pelota’s rules. Specialized balls and rackets are used.

text.label: Play Basque pelota: Cesta Punta
text.description: Catch the ball in a long, curved cesta, guide or accelerate it along the basket, and throw it at the front wall of the fronton.

text.label: Play Basque pelota: Xare
text.description: Play with a xare ring-shaped racket strung with netting: catch or briefly hold the ball and fling it with a forearm movement rather than striking it with taut strings.

text.label: Play Basque pelota: Paleta Cuero
text.description: Hit a leather pelota with a short wooden paleta toward the front wall of a fronton or trinquet.

text.label: Play Basque pelota: Pala Corta
text.description: Hit a leather pelota with a heavier, solid short wooden pala on a 36-meter fronton.

text.label: Play Basque pelota: Paleta Goma
text.description: Hit a rubber pelota with a wooden, carbon-fiber, or fiberglass paleta on a fronton or in a trinquet.

text.label: Practice sumo wrestling
text.description: Wrestle in a dohyō, trying to push an opponent out of the ring or make any part of their body other than the soles of their feet touch its inner surface.

text.label: Compete in tug of war
text.description: Pull a rope as a team in a sport competition, trying to move the opposing team beyond a designated line.

text.label: Play Icestock sport
text.description: Slide and steer a special Icestock stick over a playing surface toward a target area or in relation to other sticks. The game is played on ice in winter and on an approved hard surface in summer.

text.label: Compete in pool lifesaving
text.description: Take part in pool lifesaving by completing swimming stages, moving a mannequin, and using rescue equipment according to the discipline’s format.

text.label: Compete in beach or ocean lifesaving
text.description: Take part in beach or ocean lifesaving events, completing running, swimming, or rescue-craft stages.

text.label: Compete in a team SERC rescue simulation
text.description: As a team, assess a set emergency scenario and complete a sequence of rescue and first-aid actions within a time limit in a SERC competition. This is a controlled team competition, not a real-world rescue. Recording the whole event is valid; the simulated response actions need not be split out.

text.label: Race in a surf boat or IRB lifesaving event
text.description: Take part in lifesaving races in watercraft, including rowing rescue boats and inflatable motorized rescue boats.

text.label: Play partnership contract bridge
text.description: Play contract bridge with a partner: bid a contract and then work together to play the card tricks.

text.label: Race a powerboat on a circuit
text.description: Race a high-speed motorboat around a circuit, steering the boat and competing for speed.

text.label: Compete in an offshore powerboat race
text.description: Race a motorboat over an open-water course, competing for speed or placement.

text.label: Pilot a radio-controlled racing boat
text.description: Pilot a radio-controlled motor racing boat around a marked water course.

text.label: Race a personal watercraft
text.description: Race a motorized personal watercraft on the water.

text.label: Ride a MotoSurf board
text.description: Ride a motor-powered MotoSurf board, performing maneuvers or runs on the water.

text.label: Practice artistic cycling
text.description: Perform figures, balance elements, gymnastic and choreographic sequences on an artistic cycling bike, individually, in pairs, or in a group according to the chosen format.

text.label: Practice artistic gymnastics on apparatus
text.description: Perform gymnastics exercises and routines on one or more apparatus.

text.label: Practice artistic roller skating
text.description: Perform artistic and dance routines on roller skates, individually, in pairs, or in a group. The program type and composition depend on the chosen discipline.

text.label: Play beach hockey
text.description: Play hockey with a ball on a sand court under Beach Hockey rules.

text.label: Compete in beach wrestling
text.description: Wrestle standing inside a small circle on sand, trying to score with a throw or control, or force the opponent out of the circle.

text.label: Practice belt wrestling
text.description: Grip an opponent’s belt or clothing and use throws or holds under the rules of the selected official belt-wrestling style.

text.label: Shoot at a biathlon rifle range
text.description: Shoot at targets with a biathlon rifle during the event’s shooting stages. The equipment and rules are specific to biathlon.

text.label: Go bodysurfing
text.description: Catch a sea wave and glide along its surface using your body, without a board.

text.label: Play box lacrosse
text.description: Play a faster, contact version of lacrosse in an enclosed area, using a stick and ball under box-lacrosse rules.

text.label: Practice whitewater canoe freestyle
text.description: Perform tricks, maneuvers, and held moves in a river hole or wave using a kayak or canoe, with technique and difficulty judged.

text.label: Play canoe polo
text.description: Play a team ball game on the water, maneuvering in kayaks with paddles and passing or throwing the ball toward goals.

text.label: Practice speed climbing
text.description: Climb a standard speed-climbing route against the clock while on top-rope belay. The specific belay device depends on the venue and format.

text.label: Practice coastal endurance rowing
text.description: Row a coastal boat along an open-water course, rounding buoys and adapting to waves and wind. Course length and format depend on the race.

text.label: Practice coastal rowing
text.description: Row a rowing craft in coastal waters as part of a coastal-rowing discipline. Rowing on an ergometer and recreational boating are not included.

text.label: Practice pahlavani wrestling
text.description: Wrestle an opponent standing and on the ground, using throws and grips, including permitted grips around the belt and knee areas of specialized trousers under the style’s rules.

text.label: Practice qazaq kuresi
text.description: Wrestle standing in qazaq kuresi, gripping the opponent above the waist and using throws, trips, and hooks to try to put them on their back or both shoulders.

text.label: Play cycle ball
text.description: Play a team ball match while riding bicycles, moving the ball with the bicycle or wheel and scoring goals.

text.label: Practice cycling trials
text.description: Ride a bicycle over marked natural or artificial obstacles, controlling the bike and maintaining balance. Competition rules separately define how contact and section completion are scored.

text.label: Throw a flying disc for accuracy
text.description: Throw a flying disc at designated targets or zones to score for accuracy under the rules of the specific discipline.

text.label: Throw a flying disc for distance
text.description: Throw a flying disc as far as possible under the rules of the distance discipline; technique and measurement are set by its regulations.

text.label: Paddle a dragon boat
text.description: Paddle in synchrony as a team in a long, multi-seat boat, using single-bladed paddles in a distance race.

text.label: Drive a horse-drawn carriage
text.description: Drive a horse or team in harness and guide the horse-drawn carriage along a chosen route or around an arena.

text.label: Practice equestrian endurance riding
text.description: Ride a horse over a long route, adjusting pace and monitoring the horse’s condition across changing terrain and distance.

text.label: Practice equestrian vaulting
text.description: Perform gymnastic and expressive exercises on the back of a moving horse led by a handler on the ground.

text.label: Ski on grass
text.description: Descend a grassy slope on special roller-equipped grass skis, steering and turning as you go.

text.label: Practice speed skiing
text.description: Ski down a speed course aiming to reach and record the highest speed. Results are evaluated by the measured downhill speed.

text.label: Practice telemark skiing
text.description: Ski with free heels and make linked telemark turns: the rear ski follows the front, with the heel of the trailing foot raised.

text.label: Practice flight archery for distance
text.description: Shoot arrows with a suitable bow to achieve maximum flight distance under flight-archery rules, rather than to hit a target.

text.label: Play beach soccer
text.description: Play association football on sand, mainly moving and passing the ball with your feet, under beach-soccer rules.

text.label: Perform ski aerials
text.description: On skis, jump from a ramp, perform aerial acrobatic elements, and land on the slope.

text.label: Perform a ski big-air jump
text.description: Build speed on skis, perform one large jump or trick, and land in the landing area.

text.label: Ski in a halfpipe
text.description: Perform aerial elements on skis while riding the walls of a snow halfpipe. This is not snowboard halfpipe.

text.label: Ski moguls
text.description: Ski down a bumpy course with jumps and turns. Moguls and dual moguls are selectable competition formats.

text.label: Race in ski cross
text.description: Race on skis along a course with turns and terrain features at the same time as other competitors.

text.label: Ski slopestyle
text.description: Ski down a course with jumps and obstacles while performing judged elements.

text.label: Practice high diving
text.description: Perform acrobatic dives into water from a high platform or a suitable natural elevation. Competition heights are set by the rules for each event and category, not by one universal threshold.

text.label: Play Hockey5s
text.description: Play a short 5-a-side hockey format on a small pitch with boards or rebound walls, under Hockey5s rules.

text.label: Play indoor hockey
text.description: Play hockey with a ball in a hall on a small field with sideboards, under Indoor Hockey rules.

text.label: Practice inline freestyle skating
text.description: Perform technical maneuvers and combinations on inline skates, such as slalom, jumps, or slides. Elements depend on the chosen discipline.

text.label: Play inline hockey
text.description: Play team hockey with a puck on roller skates in a marked or enclosed rink, under inline-hockey rules.

text.label: Race on inline skates
text.description: Race on inline skates over a distance on a track or road for time or placement.

text.label: Pilot an IRB in a lifesaving race
text.description: Pilot a motorized inflatable rescue boat (IRB) around a competition course in the surf zone. This is motorboat piloting, not rowing.

text.label: Practice judo kata
text.description: Perform a predetermined sequence of judo techniques and movements in a coordinated form with a partner.

text.label: Shoot a laser pistol at a target
text.description: Aim and fire a sport laser pistol at a target in a specific discipline. Rifle shooting and firearm shooting are different activities.

text.label: Throw a rescue line in a pool event
text.description: Throw a rescue line toward a target or partner in a competitive pool event under ILS rules.

text.label: Swim while carrying or towing a rescue mannequin
text.description: Swim in a pool while carrying or towing a rescue mannequin under the rules of the specific lifesaving event.

text.label: Swim an obstacle course
text.description: Swim a pool race with prescribed obstacles under lifesaving-sport rules.

text.label: Race on a lifesaving rescue board
text.description: Paddle or swim on a rescue board over a surf course in the corresponding lifesaving race.

text.label: Complete a combined pool lifesaving event
text.description: Complete a sequence of swimming and rescue stages in a pool, including the mannequin approach required by the event rules.

text.label: Race on a lifesaving rescue ski
text.description: Paddle or steer a rescue ski over a water course in the corresponding lifesaving race.

text.label: Swim a lifesaving surf race
text.description: Swim through the surf and along a set water-course line in a competitive lifesaving discipline.

text.label: Pilot a microlight aircraft
text.description: Pilot a light powered aircraft in the microlight or ultralight class; its class and flight format follow the applicable rules.

text.label: Pilot a model aircraft in flight
text.description: Pilot a model aircraft in flight, completing flight tasks under the rules of the chosen class. Building the model is a separate activity.

text.label: Race a surfski in open water
text.description: Paddle a long, open, sit-on-top surfski kayak along a coastal or ocean route. Some races may use a downwind format.

text.label: Compete in pankration
text.description: Compete in a martial art combining permitted striking and wrestling actions under pankration rules.

text.label: Fly a paramotor
text.description: Pilot a paraglider wing with an engine under the rules for its class. This is not fixed-wing microlight flying.

text.label: Practice rhythmic gymnastics
text.description: Perform a gymnastics routine with an apparatus, combining choreographed sequences with apparatus work in an individual or group exercise.

text.label: Play rink hockey
text.description: Play team hockey with a ball, roller skates, and sticks under rink-hockey rules.

text.label: Descend a downhill course on roller skates
text.description: Descend a prepared downhill course on roller skates, controlling speed and trajectory.

text.label: Take part in roller downhill or slalom
text.description: A World Skate named family covering Downhill and Slalom. Timing the family as a whole is valid; a downhill speed run and negotiating slalom markers are separate optional actions.

text.label: Practice roller freestyle
text.description: Perform trick lines or elements on roller skates in a park, on street features, or in a vert ramp.

text.label: Skate a roller slalom course
text.description: Maneuver on roller skates between marked gates or markers in a slalom format.

text.label: Run
text.description: Run with a running stride as physical or sport practice. Route, surface, distance, pace, training, and competition format can be specified separately.

text.label: Race a radio-controlled sailboat
text.description: From shore, use a radio transmitter to change a small sailboat model’s course and sails as it competes in a fleet race.

text.label: Practice wing foiling
text.description: Stand on a board with an underwater foil, hold and steer a hand wing, and use the wind to move above the water. Competition disciplines may be specified by a separate format.

text.label: Ride a scooter in freestyle
text.description: Perform tricks and lines on a scooter in a skatepark or street setting under a freestyle competition format.

text.label: Race in short-track speed skating
text.description: Race with other skaters around a short oval ice track, completing the distance for speed.

text.label: Play snow volleyball
text.description: Play volleyball on a prepared snow court, sending the ball over a net. Snow and the stability of footwear affect movement and tactics.

text.label: Race in parallel snowboard giant slalom
text.description: Ride a snowboard through gates on a marked speed course in a parallel head-to-head race.

text.label: Race in snowboard cross
text.description: Race a snowboard course with several competitors, negotiating turns and rollers for speed.

text.label: Practice freestyle snowboarding in park or pipe
text.description: Ride a snowboard in halfpipe, slopestyle, or big air, performing judged jumps and tricks. This is not an ordinary downhill run.

text.label: Play Squash 57
text.description: Play Squash 57, also called racketball: use a racket of the specified type to hit a larger, more resilient ball against the front wall under this game’s own rules.

text.label: Row in a surf-boat race
text.description: Row as a team in a rescue surf boat over a race course in the surf zone. This is a rowing discipline, not a motorized one.

text.label: Practice synchronized skating
text.description: As a group, perform a coordinated program of movements, formations, and figures on ice.

text.label: Practice taekwondo poomsae
text.description: Perform set sequences of taekwondo techniques, stances, and movements in solo or synchronized demonstration practice.

text.label: Play Baseball5
text.description: Play Baseball5, a team game of hitting a soft ball by hand and running quickly on a compact field under Baseball5 rules.

text.label: Wakesurf
text.description: Ride a board on a wave made by a motorboat, performing turns and other maneuvers. A tow rope may be used to start or get up again, but the rider releases it during a wakesurfing pass.

text.label: Race down whitewater in a kayak or canoe
text.description: Race down a rapid river in a kayak or canoe on a sprint or classic course.

text.label: Practice bobsleigh
text.description: Ride a steerable bobsleigh down a prepared ice track, building speed at the start and steering through the turns. The chosen format may be solo (monobob) or team.

text.label: Practice a freestyle skiing discipline
text.description: Ski in a selected freestyle discipline: moguls or dual moguls, aerials, ski cross, or park and pipe (halfpipe, slopestyle, big air). The discipline type should remain available for refinement. Select a named event subtype when useful; the parent may also be selected and timed as one complete freestyle-skiing session.

text.label: Race in track luge
text.description: Lie on your back on a small racing sled and descend an artificial ice track feet first, steering with your body and legs.

text.label: Race in skeleton
text.description: Sprint to start, lie face-down and head-first on a skeleton sled, and descend an ice track steering with your body and sled.

text.label: Practice ski jumping
text.description: Build speed on special skis on a jump, take off, fly, and land; the jump is judged for distance and technique.

text.label: Wash clients’ hair
text.description: Wash a client’s hair as a professional hairdressing service.

text.label: Wave clients’ hair
text.description: Wave a client’s hair as a professional hairdressing service.

text.label: Administer institutional journal and periodical subscriptions
text.description: Maintain and renew an institution’s serial publication subscriptions; distinct from a reader purchasing a magazine or maintaining a subscriber account.

text.label: Administer and score an official licensing test
text.description: Deliver/operate an assessment required for license qualification and evaluate/score applicant responses; distinct from the applicant taking an exam, the licensing case workflow and generic output quality review.

text.label: Pilot and navigate aircraft in flight
text.description: Operate, control and navigate an aircraft during flight under established procedures, including interactions/coordination needed for safe flight. Distinct from ground/passenger travel, flight briefing, aircraft maintenance and air-traffic control.

text.label: Arrange group travel, tours and accommodation for clients
text.description: Plan and book travel/tour and accommodation services for a group or client, including bulk reservations; distinct from the traveler’s own trip, internal work scheduling, and freight routing.

text.label: Inspect returned retail goods and decide the seller’s response
text.description: Inspect goods returned by a customer and decide the retailer’s appropriate disposition (e.g. refund, replacement or rejection); distinct from buyer return, support inquiry and general quality review.

text.label: Assess ICT equipment/software needs for upgrades
text.description: Identify computer/network areas where equipment or software should be upgraded, based on performance/requirements; distinct from configuring/implementing an upgrade or routine performance monitoring.

text.label: Research and assess interior spatial/functional/safety requirements
text.description: Research and evaluate spatial, functional, efficiency, safety and aesthetic requirements that constrain an interior design before formulating the design concept; distinct from client intake, concept creation and site installation.

text.label: Assess regulated price/cost appropriateness for consumer protection
text.description: Compare regulated prices or costs of goods/services with applicable rules and evidence to determine consumer-protection appropriateness; distinct from market trend monitoring, ordinary financial analysis, tax assessment and generic compliance inspection.

text.label: Assess competitors and conditions at a sporting venue
text.description: Observe or assess other competitors and venue conditions relevant to a sporting event from a player’s perspective; distinct from official judging, site compliance inspection, spectator viewing and business market monitoring.

text.label: Help library users find and access basic library resources
text.description: Provide user-side assistance navigating a library collection/resources; distinct from guest support broadly and cataloging the collection itself.

text.label: Seize prohibited or undeclared goods under authority
text.description: Take custody of goods determined to be prohibited/undeclared under customs or immigration law; distinct from inspection, receipt/storage of regular inventory or shipping goods.

text.label: Provide childbirth/delivery care
text.description: Provide professional care during childbirth/delivery, either as the responsible practitioner or as clinical support, distinct from pregnancy advice, assessment, routine nursing care and postpartum follow-up.

text.label: Broker introductions and match buyers with sellers
text.description: Establish contact and connect prospective buyers and sellers of a commodity as an intermediary, without taking the buyer or seller’s inventory position; distinct from selling, purchasing and generic external communication.

text.label: Broker cargo space and storage capacity for clients
text.description: Source, buy/sell or negotiate access to cargo-space and related freight/storage capacity for client commodities as a broker; distinct from dispatching one’s own shipment or maintaining one’s own inventory.

text.label: Calculate interest, brokerage charges and stamp duties on a transaction
text.description: Calculate transaction-specific interest, commissions/charges and tax/stamp duty payable; distinct from business financial modeling, brokerage execution, general estimates and entering the resulting amount in accounts.

text.label: Check validity of passenger travel tickets at boarding
text.description: Verify that a passenger’s existing transport ticket, pass or boarding credential is valid for the planned journey or boarding; distinct from selling/issuing the ticket, checking identity, generic venue access control and a passenger’s self-check.

text.label: Conduct an investigative interview with a witness or suspect
text.description: Elicit and verify case information from witnesses or suspects in an authorized investigation; distinct from recruitment, customer discovery, patient intake and legal-client intake.

text.label: Contain or limit spread of hazardous substances during an incident
text.description: Limit the spread of a dangerous substance as part of a fire/accident response; distinct from hazard assessment, routine waste management and general incident coordination.

text.label: Coordinate train routings within a railway division or zone
text.description: Direct the routing of trains through the assigned rail network division/zone and retain the operational records; distinct from driving trains, passenger route planning and generic freight dispatch.

text.label: Design plating and decorative food displays
text.description: Determine visual presentation and create decorative displays/plating for prepared food; distinct from cooking, interior/display-space design and decorating a retail merchandise window.

text.label: Cultivate biological laboratory cultures
text.description: Grow/cultivate biological cultures or organisms as a laboratory operation, distinct from preparing a sample/reagent, collecting the source specimen or testing/analyzing the culture.

text.label: Develop or refine recipes
text.description: Create or refine a recipe or culinary formula, distinct from deciding which dishes appear on a menu, preparing ingredients, or cooking a meal. Professional or household setting and intended diners are facets.

text.label: Respond to animal-control complaints and take authorized custody of stray animals
text.description: Handle a public animal-control case by responding to animal complaints, issuing authorized warnings or citations, and impounding stray animals when authorized. Distinguish public-control work from owner-side pet care, animal husbandry and ordinary customer complaints.

text.label: Enter data from source documents into a computer repository
text.description: Transcribe numbers/codes/text from source material into a database or electronic processing system; distinct from validating/correcting entered values, analyzing data and migrating data between systems.

text.label: Exchange one currency for another at a service counter
text.description: Convert a customer’s cash from one currency into another as a requested counter service; distinct from analyzing FX markets, receiving a payment, paying an invoice or the customer’s own currency exchange.

text.label: Execute or sign an agreement for a represented party
text.description: Sign or execute a negotiated agreement on behalf of a principal under delegated authority; distinct from drafting/reviewing/negotiating the document or personally signing one’s own consumer contract.

text.label: Fight and extinguish fires as a professional responder
text.description: Respond to and extinguish fires as an emergency-service action.

text.label: Fit wigs and hairpieces to customer requirements
text.description: Fit a wig or hairpiece to a client’s requirements; distinct from natural-hair styling and the customer wearing/adjusting their own wig.

text.label: Prepare and submit a flight plan
text.description: Create, complete and submit a professional aircraft flight-plan document for a flight, distinct from receiving a preflight briefing, approving another operator’s plan or navigating in flight.

text.label: Review and approve a flight plan
text.description: Examine a flight plan and approve/clear it for operational use in the relevant aviation role, distinct from preparing/submitting the plan, general air-traffic control and a preflight briefing.

text.label: Analyse work methods/resource efficiency
text.description: Collect or analyse operational data about work methods, sequence, resource use and productivity to improve efficiency/safety; distinct from general project resource planning or process documentation.

text.label: Assess insured loss, damage and policy liability
text.description: Assess the extent of insured loss/damage and the liability of an insurer/underwriter under policy coverage; distinct from generic cost estimation, claim-file administration, and the insured claimant’s personal claim handling.

text.label: Assess customer insurance needs and insurable risk
text.description: Elicit a customer’s circumstances and determine the type/degree of insurance coverage and risk required; distinct from customer-side insurance administration, explaining/quoting a product, or handling a claim.

text.label: Monitor use/consumption of laboratory supplies
text.description: Observe and track how laboratory consumables are being used over time to control remaining quantity/quality and anticipate project needs. Keep separate from sample testing, receiving a delivery, retail stocktaking and project cost estimation.

text.label: Develop, standardize and validate laboratory methods
text.description: Create, standardize, evaluate or modify laboratory procedures, methods and tests, including checking result accuracy; distinct from preparing a session, conducting a test or following an established protocol.

text.label: Label pharmaceutical preparations for professional stock
text.description: Apply or prepare identification labels for drugs, chemicals or pharmaceutical preparations handled in professional stock; distinct from compounding a product, dispensing it to a recipient, recording a care event, and replenishing shelves.

text.label: Gather law-enforcement intelligence for crime prevention/investigation
text.description: Research, verify and compile information about alleged offences or security concerns.

text.label: Collect and maintain animal health/care records
text.description: Record animal weight, condition, treatments, medication and feeding information in animal-care work; distinct from human clinical documentation and an owner’s pet log.

text.label: Maintain records of securities transactions for a client or employer
text.description: Maintain transaction/position records of bonds, shares or other securities bought or sold for a client/employer; distinct from executing trades, advising on investments, and generic accounting that does not expose this financial register subtype.

text.label: Persuade a customer to stop drinking, decline further service, and order transportation
text.description: As a service provider, intervene to limit a customer's alcohol consumption by asking them to stop drinking, declining further service and arranging transportation.

text.label: Modify an existing technical device or system
text.description: Alter the configuration or construction of an existing technical device or system, including navigation equipment and prosthetic or supportive devices. Modification is distinct from routine adjustment, repair and assembling a new product.

text.label: Monitor contract performance and service fulfilment
text.description: Track whether a counterparty makes an agreed service available in the required format and time and escalate deviations; distinct from drafting/reviewing a contract, signing it, and providing the purchased service oneself.

text.label: Monitor culinary quality of dishes throughout preparation/presentation
text.description: Check taste, appearance and preparation quality of dishes throughout kitchen production and presentation; distinct from food-safety compliance, routine cooking and a final point inspection.

text.label: Monitor publications and select/file articles relevant to clients or staff
text.description: Review current publications, identify articles of interest to a defined client/staff audience and save/clip them for use; distinct from casual reading or archiving a collection.

text.label: Obtain authorization to sell at a market/street location
text.description: As a vendor, apply for/obtain required permission or license to establish a stall or sell food in a public place; distinct from the authority reviewing/granting an application.

text.label: Operate library/gallery audiovisual and reprographic equipment
text.description: Operate AV presentation/projection and reproduction/copy equipment in a gallery, museum or library; distinct from installing equipment, creating media content and producing a print run.

text.label: Participate in a media interview as an interviewee
text.description: Answer a journalist/media interviewer’s questions as an interviewee; distinct from conducting an interview, public speaking, writing promotional content and ordinary business communication.

text.label: Fit and adjust a prescribed assistive/prosthetic device for a patient
text.description: Fit a patient-specific assistive/prosthetic device and assess/adjust its fit, function and comfort for the patient, distinct from device manufacture, equipment installation, repair, calibration or the patient’s own use.

text.label: Place or arrange an insurance/reinsurance contract
text.description: Arrange placement of an insurance or reinsurance contract with an insurer/underwriter or insurance market; distinct from advising customers, negotiating terms, reviewing contract language and administering a claim.

text.label: Prepare a computer peripheral for a processing run
text.description: Read job setup instructions, select equipment/media/settings, load a computer peripheral and oversee run preparation; distinct from routine machine operation, software configuration and freight loading.

text.label: Receive and process orders for classified advertisements
text.description: Register a customer’s classified-ad order and apply applicable rate-card pricing before billing; distinct from writing/editing ad copy or preparing a customer invoice.

text.label: Process personnel applications for employment or promotion
text.description: Receive, register, route and process job/promotion applications and communicate the result as personnel administration; distinct from the applicant writing their own application, candidate sourcing, and the manager deciding whom to hire/promote.

text.label: Process insurance policy lifecycle transactions
text.description: Handle insurer-side processing across policy enrollment, cancellation, claims transactions, policy changes and associated payments. These are lifecycle transaction types under one selectable insurance-administration family; distinguish transaction type and role as facets. This does not imply underwriting, selling a policy, assessing claim merits, or a policyholder filing a claim.

text.label: Make a patient-specific prosthetic fitting impression
text.description: Create a patient-specific cast/impression/pattern for fabricating an orthotic/prosthetic appliance, distinct from clinical diagnosis, device design or fabrication from an existing pattern.

text.label: Provide professional beauty, cosmetic and nail/foot-care services
text.description: Provide client-facing beauty and personal-care services: skin cleansing/cream or lotion application, facial/body massage, makeup, nail care, foot-ailment care, bath-client service, and waxing/sugaring/depilation. The exact service and provider/recipient context remain facets; this does not imply diagnosis or clinical treatment.

text.label: Provide professional hairdressing and barbering services
text.description: Provide hairdressing and barbering services for clients, including cutting, washing, colouring, waving, styling, facial-hair grooming, scalp care and extensions.

text.label: Provide non-pharmacological pain relief within an established care plan
text.description: Provide provider-side massage or other non-pharmacological pain relief support (including pregnancy/labor contexts) under a plan; distinct from clinical pain diagnosis, pharmacological treatment and self-relief.

text.label: Arrange real-estate contract closing and transfer of property rights
text.description: Coordinate the signing/closing of a property sale or lease and the associated conveyance or transfer of rights; distinct from negotiating/drafting terms or performing the registry/legal filing itself.

text.label: Release pledged collateral after loan repayment
text.description: Return an item held as loan security when the borrower repays the loan; distinct from commercial product returns, inventory receipt and sale of defaulted collateral.

text.label: Retrieve, sort and route computer-processing output
text.description: Retrieve and sort output from computer programs and deliver the resulting data/files to the designated users; distinct from querying a dataset for analysis, transforming records, or sending an analytical report.

text.label: Construct, maintain and use a survey sampling frame
text.description: Establish and maintain registers and sampling frames that operationally define a census or survey population and support sample selection; distinct from fielding the survey or maintaining a general administrative register.

text.label: Scan or weigh merchandise and record its checkout price
text.description: Identify/measure a product at point of sale and enter or retrieve the price for the cashier total; distinct from stocktaking, product display, lab measurement and seller payment receipt.

text.label: Screen or triage meeting and appointment requests
text.description: Review incoming requests for a meeting or appointment, decide whether/when they should proceed or be routed, and prioritize them before calendar scheduling. Distinct from reading/routing correspondence alone and from booking an already accepted meeting.

text.label: Assess wagering risk, set odds and manage bookmaker exposure
text.description: Estimate risk and set betting odds and decisions to hedge/decline exposure as a bookmaker; distinct from a customer placing a bet, financial reporting and croupier game facilitation.

text.label: Set retail product assortment, stock levels and price levels
text.description: Decide what goods/variants to carry, in what quantities and at what price; distinct from counting existing stock, displaying a product and executing a sale.

text.label: Set up kegs, taps and beverage supply lines
text.description: Connect beverage supply lines and tap kegs for bar dispensing; distinct from serving a drink, installing general appliances or maintaining non-beverage equipment.

text.label: Shelve and re-shelve library materials in the collection
text.description: Place books, periodicals and other library materials into assigned shelf locations for browsing/retrieval; distinct from warehouse stock replenishment and collection cataloging.

text.label: Select/specify materials, furniture and products for an interior
text.description: Select, specify and recommend furnishings/materials/products to meet functional and aesthetic criteria in an interior; distinct from purchasing them, creating a product, or designing the overall spatial concept.

text.label: Import/export or transfer records between existing systems
text.description: Move existing data from one database/software system to another; distinct from cleaning/transformation for analysis, designing a repeatable ETL pipeline and administering databases.

text.label: Verify buyer age eligibility before a restricted sale
text.description: Check proof of age as a provider-side sale-compliance step; distinct from government identity verification or the buyer presenting ID as a personal action.

text.label: Verify a hotel guest’s payment/credit authorization
text.description: Check a guest’s payment/credit authorization at room assignment/check-in, as a provider-side lodging control; distinct from processing the payment, underwriting a loan and the guest checking their own credit.

text.label: Verify property title, legal description and ownership
text.description: Examine title, lien, judgment, easement, contract and map records to establish the legal description and ownership of property; distinct from market-value appraisal, contract drafting, conveyance and general document filing.

text.label: Assist with artificial insemination of animals
text.description: Assist with the technical tasks of artificial insemination in veterinary or animal-production work.

text.label: Weigh goods within receipt, production, issue or dispatch and keep records
text.description: Measure the weight of goods as an inventory/transport control at receipt, production, issue or dispatch, recording the weight; distinct from scientific measurement, measuring/marking trade materials, and merely receiving/storing/shipping a shipment.

text.label: Operate a boiler or steam utility system
text.description: Operate a boiler, steam plant, and related auxiliary equipment to provide energy and utility services.

text.label: Extract rock or mineral material
text.description: Extract rock, ore, coal, and other mineral materials.

text.label: Carry out blasting work
text.description: Carry out blasting or material-fragmentation work at a mining, construction, or demolition site.

text.label: Process ore and extract mineral products
text.description: Process mineral raw material, separating and preparing useful products or concentrates.

text.label: Clear agricultural drainage ditches
text.description: Clear agricultural drainage ditches to maintain the land.

text.label: Fell trees and prepare timber
text.description: Harvest timber in a forest by felling trees, removing branches, and preparing trunks for further processing.

text.label: Watch for fires in a forest area
text.description: Monitor a forest area to detect and report signs of fire.

text.label: Prepare a forest site and regenerate woodland
text.description: Assess and prepare a forest site for regeneration, establish new stands, and tend young growth. Species, site, and stage of work can be specified separately.

text.label: Gather, stack, or move hay and straw
text.description: Gather, stack, and move hay and straw for storage, animal feed, or bedding.

text.label: Assess and maintain farm-animal health
text.description: Assess farm animals’ condition and maintain their health through care, prevention, and appropriate veterinary support.

text.label: Prepare and maintain commercial fishing gear
text.description: Prepare, repair, and maintain commercial fishing gear.

text.label: Raise and rear non-domesticated animals
text.description: Breed, raise, and keep non-domesticated animals in a managed operation to produce goods or replenish populations. Distinguish this from hunting and keeping animals for leisure.

text.label: Lift and position loads with hoisting equipment
text.description: Raise, lower, move, and position materials or equipment using hoisting machinery.

text.label: Secure and distribute a load in a vehicle
text.description: Place and secure cargo in a vehicle and distribute it for transport.

text.label: Convert paper and cardboard into finished products
text.description: Convert sheet or roll paper and cardboard into containers, bags, envelopes, and other finished products; distinguish this from packaging finished goods.

text.label: Forge and shape metal
text.description: Forge and shape metal blanks and products.

text.label: Make concrete, stone, or mineral construction products
text.description: Make and finish precast concrete, artificial-stone, and other mineral construction products.

text.label: Make a foundry mold or core
text.description: Make, prepare, and repair foundry molds and cores used to produce metal goods.

text.label: Produce pulp or paper
text.description: Produce pulp and paper sheets from cellulosic raw materials.

text.label: Mold and manufacture plastic products
text.description: Mold and manufacture parts and products from plastic.

text.label: Manufacture rubber products
text.description: Manufacture parts and products from rubber.

text.label: Manufacture semiconductor chips
text.description: Manufacture semiconductor chips and components.

text.label: Plate or coat a product surface
text.description: Apply a protective or decorative coating to a product, including electroplating and metallized coatings.

text.label: Process tobacco: prepare raw tobacco or manufacture tobacco products
text.description: Prepare raw tobacco or manufacture tobacco products. The recorded activity can be further identified by its processing stage.

text.label: Manufacture or process formulated chemical products
text.description: Manufacture or process chemical and other formulated products in an industrial plant. The product category, process and equipment can be specified separately.

text.label: Process primary metal by refining, casting, or forming
text.description: Operate or monitor primary-metal processing, including refining, purifying, casting, rolling, heat treatment and extrusion. The processing stage, material and equipment can be specified separately.

text.label: Process logs into lumber or wood panels
text.description: Saw logs into lumber and produce veneer, plywood, and wood panels.

text.label: Evaluate the taste, aroma, or sensory qualities of food or drink
text.description: Evaluate the taste, aroma, and other sensory properties of foods and beverages, and record tasting results.

text.label: Shape and process glass
text.description: Shape and process glass to make a product or component.

text.label: Tan and finish hides or fur
text.description: Process hides and fur into leather or fur material, and sort, finish, and dye the material.

text.label: Treat and preserve wood or lumber
text.description: Dry, impregnate, protect, and otherwise treat wood or finished wooden products.

text.label: Weave baskets and products from rattan, willow, or reed
text.description: Weave baskets, furniture, and other products from willow, rattan, reed, and similar flexible materials.

text.label: Wind coils for electrical components
text.description: Wind wire coils for electrical and electronic components.

text.label: Wash and polish windows and glass surfaces
text.description: Wash and polish windows, shop windows, and other glass surfaces.

text.label: Professionally dry-clean textiles and leather goods
text.description: Clean clothing, textiles, and leather goods as a professional dry-cleaning service.

text.label: Apply and finish plaster surfaces
text.description: Apply plaster or similar compounds to walls, ceilings, and other surfaces, then finish them.

text.label: Assemble and erect temporary construction scaffolding
text.description: Assemble, erect, and dismantle temporary construction scaffolding.

text.label: Excavate, grade, or compact earth
text.description: Excavate, move, grade, level, and compact soil and similar materials at a construction site.

text.label: Hang wallpaper and wall coverings
text.description: Prepare surfaces and hang wallpaper or other flexible wall coverings.

text.label: Rig and position suspended equipment or structures
text.description: Prepare lifting rigging and position suspended equipment, materials, or structures.

text.label: Join or splice cable, rope, or wire
text.description: Join and splice cables, ropes, or wires during installation and repair.

text.label: Clean and restore contaminated or damaged building surfaces
text.description: Clean and restore contaminated or damaged building surfaces by removing contaminants, mold, soot, or damaged layers.

text.label: Upholster or reupholster furniture and seats
text.description: Make, install, repair, or replace padded upholstery on furniture, seats, and other objects.

text.label: Couple rail vehicles and assemble a train
text.description: Couple and uncouple rail vehicles and assemble a train from rolling stock.

text.label: Moor a vessel and handle its lines
text.description: Moor a vessel and handle its mooring lines, ropes, and equipment.

text.label: Prepare a working animal for transport or farm work
text.description: Prepare a working animal to perform a transport or agricultural task.

text.label: Install and maintain power lines
text.description: Install, maintain, and repair overhead or underground power lines and electric traction lines.

text.label: Work on a quilt project
text.description: A project or session umbrella chosen by the user for design, piecing, basting, quilting, binding, and finishing. Component actions may be tracked separately and concurrently as overlapping, non-additive views.

text.label: Quilt layered textiles
text.description: Stitch through layers of textile to join them and/or decorate them. The top may be wholecloth, pieced, or appliquéd; hand and machine quilting differ by method. Piecing a quilt top is a separate operation.

text.label: Do carpentry and home repair
text.description: Measure, fit, join, or install wooden elements, doors, shelves, furniture, or trim when building, repairing, or improving a home. Payment and professional status are not inferred from the activity.

text.label: Carve wood
text.description: Carve a shape, image, ornament, or other feature from wood by removing material with suitable carving tools. Making an object, creating artwork, and restoring a wooden part can be different contexts for this activity.

text.label: Practice canoe slalom
text.description: Practice navigating slalom gates in a canoe on a water course, or take part in a corresponding competition. Recreational paddling and sprint racing are not automatically slalom.

text.label: Practice or race canoe sprint
text.description: Practice canoe sprint paddling or take part in a corresponding race. Distance, boat class, and event format are specified separately; gate slalom is a different discipline.

text.label: Practice downhill mountain biking
text.description: Practice descending a mountain-bike course, whether prepared or natural, in training or competition. Simply riding downhill during any bike outing does not necessarily mean this discipline was chosen.

text.label: Practice enduro mountain biking
text.description: Practice enduro mountain biking or take part in an enduro competition. A competition session typically combines timed downhill stages and transfers; the event, not this activity card, defines its specific rules.

text.label: Ride mountain-bike trails
text.description: Ride a mountain bike on trails and off-road routes in a trail-riding style. This may be independent recreational riding without a race; location, surface, and intensity are optional details.

text.label: Practice cross-country mountain biking
text.description: Ride a mountain bike in a cross-country format on varied terrain with climbs and descents. Training, recreational riding, and a particular competition format are specified separately.

text.label: Practice Nordic walking
text.description: Practice Nordic walking by walking while actively using specialized poles to propel and engage the body. It is a distinct walking technique; ordinary support with trekking poles does not automatically count as Nordic walking.

text.label: Compete in a handcycling para-cycling event
text.description: Take part in a para-cycling competition on a handcycle, such as a road race, individual time trial, or relay. Class and format are specified for the particular event, not inferred from the device alone.

text.label: Play POP Tennis
text.description: Play POP Tennis according to the selected format of this racquet sport. POP Tennis, APTA platform tennis, and padel are distinct sports; the ambiguous word “paddle” alone does not establish which one was chosen.

text.label: Practice qigong
text.description: Perform a chosen qigong practice involving movement and/or held postures, breath work, and attention. Forms may be more active or more still; purpose and tradition are not inferred automatically, and no therapeutic effect is promised.

text.label: Practice race walking
text.description: Practice race walking as an athletics discipline with defined requirements for ground contact and a straightened leg. Training and competition differ by context; Nordic walking with poles is a different activity.

text.label: Take part in an athletics relay
text.description: Compete in a team relay race; distance and mode of movement are subordinate discipline and format facets.

text.label: Spearfish underwater
text.description: Hunt fish underwater. The diving method is specified separately; breath-holding without hunting and observing the underwater environment are different activities.

text.label: Do fast or interval wheelchair propulsion for fitness
text.description: Propel a manual wheelchair for exercise in a chosen fast or interval-based training mode. “Run” does not mean running on foot, imply a universal speed, or establish medical status.

text.label: Do leisure-pace wheelchair propulsion for fitness
text.description: Propel a manual wheelchair for exercise at a chosen walking pace. This is the person’s own physical practice; everyday mobility, accompanying another person, and racing are distinct contexts.

text.label: Practice or compete in automotive slalom
text.description: Drive a car around a closed course through a marked sequence of cones or other control markers, negotiating them in order with accuracy and control; the run may be timed and include penalties. Practice and competition belong to the same base activity; rules for a specific event are specified separately.

text.label: Navigate a powered recreational boat on a route (UIM Pleasure Navigation)
text.description: As the operator or pilot of a powered recreational boat, actively plan and steer it along a route or course when route handling or navigation practice is itself the activity. This includes UIM regularity or course competitions, social rallies, training, demonstrations, skill checks, and intentional non-competitive navigation practice. A chosen destination alone, a trip made to get somewhere, or a passenger cruise does not constitute this separate activity; rowing, sailing, and closed-course motorboat racing are also excluded.
